description: This file defines the Mem class for caching using Memcache within the Opencart system. It provides methods to get, set, and delete cache entries, managing connection setup and expiration times.

classes.name: Mem
classes.description: A class encapsulating Memcache cache storage with methods to get, set, and delete cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcache connection and sets the expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with a specified key and expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.
